Macrons

Consonantal i

Household, washing & chores

glue noun and verb

also glue together, gluing, paste

classical

Traupman 321
Verg. G. 4.40

glūten, glūtinis n.

noun, third declension

Examples

  • Fractum est? Glūtināre possumus.

    Is it broken? We can glue it.composed

Other words

  • glūtinō, glūtināre — glue, glue together

    verb, first conjugation · classical · Traupman 321; Plin.

See also sticky tape, stick on, needle.
